fulfillmentDescriptions.SUCCEEDED: Auth is enforcing the entitlement. Revocation takes effect on the next request.
fulfillmentDescriptions.FAILED: The entitlement authority rejected or could not complete the last attempt. Review the evidence and retry.

fulfillmentDescriptions.EXPIRED: The approved entitlement reached its policy end time and is no longer effective.
